text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Uses article quotations and explains their impact","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its claims in specific evidence from the source rather than relying mainly on unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"Pollution, safety, law, and consumer benefit points","quality":"reasoned development","description":"The essay develops several linked reasons for its position instead of repeating the same idea in different words."},{"evidence":"Counter argument to the law issue","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a possible objection and briefly responds to it, which makes the argument feel more balanced."},{"evidence":"“In conclusion” paragraph that restates the stance","quality":"organization","description":"The essay follows a clearer argumentative structure with an introduction, supporting body paragraphs, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"“amazing drop in pollution” and “drive us to greatness”","quality":"persuasive emphasis","description":"The essay uses stronger affirmative language to present driverless cars as beneficial and forward-looking."}]}
